How to export your data from Lillio (HiMama)

Self-serve exports, what to request from support, and the checklist that protects your records.

Lillio (the platform long known as HiMama) holds a lot of irreplaceable material for a typical program — years of daily documentation and photos. Whether you're switching or just building a backup, here's the clean path out. Do it before cancelling.

Step 1 — Self-serve exports from the web dashboard

  • Roster/enrolment — children, rooms, family contacts.
  • Attendance — widest available date range, exported per room and per child.
  • Billing & payments — invoices and transactions per family, summary and detail. Tax season and payment disputes both want the detail.
  • Reports/documentation — export or print-to-PDF the development documentation you care about (portfolios, learning stories) — this is Lillio's strength and the thing programs most regret losing.

Step 2 — The support request

From the owner/admin email, request: bulk export of all photos and videos, complete daily-report history, and anything not exposed in dashboard reports. Be specific ("all media for all classrooms, full history, delivered as a download link"). Allow two to three weeks before your intended cancellation date.

Step 3 — Checklist

  • ☐ Roster + family contacts
  • ☐ Attendance history
  • ☐ Billing/payment history (keep 6 years)
  • ☐ Year-end receipts issued to families
  • ☐ Daily reports / learning documentation (PDF)
  • ☐ Photos & videos (bulk, via support)
  • ☐ Medical/allergy/immunization notes
  • ☐ Staff records

Step 4 — If this export is a switch

Frequently asked questions

Can I export photos from Lillio/HiMama in bulk?
Families can save individual photos, but program-wide bulk export generally goes through a support request from the account owner. Ask while your subscription is active and allow a couple of weeks.
What data should I keep after leaving Lillio?
Roster and contacts, attendance, billing and payment history (6 years for CRA), daily report/development documentation you want for portfolios, immunization and allergy notes, staff records, and photos/videos.
Does Lillio delete my data after I cancel?
Expect your access to end with the subscription and retention to follow their policies. The safe assumption for any platform: export everything before the end date rather than relying on post-cancellation retrieval.
